_purpose: The authoritative list of test files that MUST exist in test_harness/ and MUST be discovered by run_all.sh's own glob patterns (verify_*.js, verify_*.py, find_*.py). Distinct from FILE_MANIFEST.json's job (checksums, for detecting *content* drift) -- this file's only job is detecting *membership* drift: a test silently going missing, or a new test silently never being cross-checked against this list. Updated ONLY when a test is genuinely, deliberately added or removed -- never on a routine run, never automatically. verify_file_integrity.js reads this file and fails loudly if the real, current test_harness/ directory and this list ever disagree in either direction.
_last_updated_reason: Initial creation, per direct operator request: 'a way to validate that all tests are actually in the test_harness and tested via the run_all script... there should be a master test_suite and source list that is only updated when new tests are added or properly removed'.
_how_to_update: Only touch this file in the same turn a test is genuinely added or removed, as part of that change -- never as a separate 'sync' pass. Add/remove exactly the one filename that changed; do not regenerate the whole list from a fresh directory scan (that would silently paper over a real membership drift instead of catching it).
